messages:
marta: FYI — after the 01:55 deploy we're seeing OTEL sampling drift in APAC GPU pools and a sharp rise in dropped spans. Prom alert otel-span-loss-apac just fired.

devon: I see it too in the gateway logs. The rollout v3.14 changed batching behavior. 5xxs to inference-gateway up ~0.6% and span export counts down ~40%.

sre-bot: Alert: otel-span-loss-apac (sev2) triggered at 2026-03-18T02:03:12Z — sustained 3m. Related: gpu-pool-heartbeat-elevated, gateway-5xx-increase.

luca: please paste a raw gateway log where exporter drops spans so I can check headers/conn resets.

marta: pasted truncated gateway-2a logs below:
```
2026-03-18T01:59:58Z INF ingest.gateway request_id=abc123 conn=reset span_exporter=otlp dropped_spans=1143 reason="timeout_write"
2026-03-18T02:00:01Z INF ingest.gateway request_id=def456 span_count=1 traceparent=00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
```

anika: timeline: deploy finished ~01:55, sampling/batching toggles applied ~01:56, alerts at 02:03. Looks like exporter-level backpressure during burst.

devon: I reproduced locally by switching the batcher to max_delay_ms=150 and export_timeout_ms=200 — exporter cancels writes under tail latency and buffered spans get dropped.

luca: hypothesis: load spike -> exporter write latency -> SDK cancels batches -> spans dropped. Quick experiments to try: 
1) increase export_timeout_ms to 1000 on gateway OTLP exporter
2) reduce batch max_size (e.g., 100 -> 50)

marta: +1. Also need to confirm traceparent propagation through our egress proxy. I spotted traces that have request logs but missing traceparent.

devon: quick curl test to validate propagation:
```
curl -v 'https://gateway.apac.redwood.dev/health' -H 'traceparent: 00-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa-0000000000000001-01'
# then check gateway access logs for the incoming traceparent
```

anika: pushed a staging patch to raise exporter timeout and enabled OTEL SDK debug logs for 10m to capture exporter errors. Monitoring staging metrics now.

luca: for alert tuning: current rule otel_span_loss_apac = "dropped_spans_rate > 50 for 5m". We should scope by pool_name and deploy_rev, and add a short burn-in (3/10m) to avoid noisy pages on short spikes. Also consider a recording rule for exporter_write_latency histogram to decouple transient GC from actual loss.

marta: agree. Add pool and deploy_rev labels, change alert to require sustained across two windows, and create follow-up to add the exporter_write_latency recording rule.

devon: note on cost: increasing timeouts and smaller batches will raise OTLP traffic and per-span storage costs. Need an ops cost estimate before permanent config change.

anika: I'll run a cost simulation with current throughput and the proposed staging config and post numbers by EOD.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-039 created for otel exporter backpressure APAC. Owner: anika. Status: investigating.

marta: plan: get a staging config that avoids dropped spans, then propose tuned alerting + cost tradeoffs. If needed, I can approve a short prod rollback/mitigation.

luca: tracking tasks: 
- [ ] staging config changes (anika)
- [ ] prod short mitigation (increase timeout) (marta)
- [ ] alert label + burn-in tweak (devon)
- [ ] cost sim (anika)

anika: will post staging graphs and exporter debug logs in ~12m.
